mods.description: VS IMPOSTOR IS BACK!A from-the-ground-up remaster of the 2023 mod, VS IMPOSTOR V4! We've brought members of the community together and have translated the mod into 28 languages!EXPANDED COSMICUBE!Legacy's Cosmicube has been heavily expanded compared to the original from 2023. With tons of new skins and pets to find, you'll have a lot more to find and discover!AWARDSThere are 28 new awards for you to unlock! Will you get them all?BRAND-NEW DLC!With 5 new songs, and an entirely new Cosmicube, the SECURITY DLC will be made available when Legacy launches on April 25th!To install, just drag and drop the "securitydlc" folder into the content folderStill need help? mods.title: PIBBY APOCALYPSE | REVAMPED
mods.description: WARNING:This mod contains flashing lights, intense visual effects, and loud sounds. Review the visual settings before playing and stop if the effects cause discomfort.“Pibby Apocalypse: Revamped” is an updated version of the original 2023 demo, featuring revamped graphics, stage effects, transitions, and menus. Play through seven main tracks, and immerse yourself in the atmosphere and visual style created by our “ColStorm Crew” team.We made "PA: Revamped" out of our love and respect for Pibby Apocalypse and the work of its original creators. This is an unofficial fan-made project created in honor of the original mod. It is in no way affiliated with the original Pibby Apocalypse development team.This is Part 1 of “PA: Revamped” — the first of three planned parts and just the beginning of our journey.We still have so much we want to share with you, and this first release is our first step toward bringing this vision to life. Currently, part 1 includes the following tracks:Child’s PlayMy Amazing WorldRETCONForgotten WorldBlessed By SwordsBrotherly LoveSuffering SiblingsWe thank you from the bottom of our hearts for your support! Whether you’ve been following the development, sharing our work, helping to test the mod, or discovering it for the first time today—we’re so glad you’re with us! We’ve poured a lot of time, care, and love into this project, and the chance to finally share this first part with you means the world to our team. We hope you’ll stay with us until the end of this journey. There’s still a lot ahead, and we look forward to continuing to create it together with you.With love, ColStorm Crew

mods.title: Funkin' Loading Screen [FAN RECREATION]
mods.description: Funkin' Loading Screen is a Psych Engine Modules mod that adds a Loading animation following the base game style that will be coming in the upcoming week 8 update! The look in this mod is just a FAN RECREATION, so hopefully you like the results. You can adjust the Artwork settings on the Background in the mod menu options ↓HOW TO CUSTOMIZE YOUR OWN ARTWORK1. Prepare an image with a resolution of 1280x7202. Edit the image in Ibis Paint or something similar, give it a 10px Lens Blur filter, and a brightness of -90% (recommended to be the same as the default)3. Rename the image name with the names between placeholder1, placeholder2, placeholder34. Place the image into "Funkin Loading/images/loading/custom_artwork" and overwrite the old placeholder with your placeholder image.5. Congratulations, now you can use it, use the Custom settings in the Options menu to try it out!DON'T UNDERSTAND? TRY WATCHING THE FOLLOWING VIDEO TUTORIAL!The assets of this module are entirely owned by Funkin' Crewhttps://github.com/FunkinCrew/funkin.assets/commit/7ad396e54a437da7916ee27ee68415a3485e934dANIMATIONS PREVIEWBF & GF ANIMATIONSPLACEHOLDER IMAGESCUSTOM ARTWORK EXAMPLE
